ArchitectureNotes.objective: Converge the platform on the single-user channel-aware target model: media_asset to collection/inbox to immutable selection_snapshot to analysis_run to artifacts, with channel surfaces kept outside product lifecycle.
ArchitectureNotes.document-role: GRACE execution backbone for bottom-up implementation after media-36a.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Do not preserve old public product architecture, grouped submission modes, or route alias layers as the target state.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Contract drift can reintroduce immediate-execution wording and split adapters away from one API-owned product model.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: Mutable collections can accidentally leak into already started analysis unless selections are immutable snapshots.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: Rejected media can disappear unless diagnostics are modeled before adapter work.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-4: Transcription can silently regress to a removed legacy ASR path unless runtime, dependency, compose, docs, and tests all enforce CopperASR as the only active backend.

TargetArchitectureReset.decision: The product is single-user at this stage. Workspaces, workspace members, owners tables, and team authorization are deferred until a real product requirement appears.

Channels are durable integration identities and presentation surfaces, not product owners. API tables store channel_accounts and channel_surfaces so Telegram, Web, and MCP can recover UI state after restarts without owning business state.

The target storage model uses channel_accounts, operation_requests, stored_objects, media_assets, collections, collection_items, selection_snapshots, selection_snapshot_items, analysis_runs, analysis_run_steps, analysis_run_step_inputs, analysis_run_events, artifacts, artifact_subjects, diagnostics, channel_surfaces, channel_surface_subjects, and channel_surface_events.

The current local database is disposable for this rebuild. Do not preserve rows, broadly backfill current records, or prove no data loss for current local data. The governed media rollout explicitly permits only metadata-enrichment enqueue for existing supported YouTube URL assets after canonical id extraction; it copies no provider media bytes.
Removed implementation names survive only as historical deletion evidence or negative regression checks. Target contracts, code, and active docs use target names only.

TargetRebuildStages.stage: Make docs, Beads, and GRACE agree on the target model.
Expose only target DTO names before runtime changes.
Delete/recreate or rebuild target tables from an empty local database; provide deterministic seed/fixture setup instead of preserving current rows.
Make API the only owner of product state, channel surfaces, idempotency, diagnostics, and retention.
Move Telegram to channel_accounts, channel_surfaces, target callbacks, and restart recovery.
Move workers to analysis_run_steps and sealed selection_snapshots.
Move Web and MCP to target vocabulary and operations.
Prove every user flow, table invariant, API operation, worker path, and channel recovery path.
Pin CopperASR as a submodule/runtime service, remove legacy ASR surfaces, and prove provider-agnostic adapter behavior before the E2E coverage wave.

GuidingArchitecture.principle: API owns durable product state and all single-user/channel-account access checks.
media_asset is created before analysis and can exist without any run.
collection and inbox are management surfaces, not execution requests.
selection_snapshot is the only bridge from accumulated media into execution.
analysis_run is the public execution surface; analysis_run_steps and analysis_run_step_inputs are internal execution planning state.
Artifacts, diagnostics, retention, and event history are first-class run outputs.
Telegram, Web, and MCP are adapters over the same API state.

Entity.name: media_asset
Entity.purpose: Durable API-owned input record for one user-provided material.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, stored_object_id, input_kind, origin, display_name, status, metadata, diagnostic_id, retention_policy_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

invariants.rule: Belongs to exactly one channel account in the current single-user product.
Appears in the default inbox collection by default after successful creation.
Invalid or quarantined assets remain visible through diagnostics.

Entity.name: stored_object
Entity.purpose: API-owned object storage and origin metadata behind media assets and artifacts.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, object_key, external_uri, text_ref, checksum, size_bytes, mime_type, metadata, expires_at, created_at

invariants.rule: Object bodies are written through API-owned ingestion and artifact paths.
Object retention can expire body access without deleting historical run metadata.

Entity.name: collection
Entity.purpose: Channel-account-scoped grouping of media_asset records, including inbox.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, kind, name, status, version, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, deleted_at

invariants.rule: Each channel account has exactly one active inbox.
Collection membership is mutable and version checked.

Entity.name: selection_snapshot
Entity.purpose: Immutable ordered snapshot prepared for analysis.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, status, option_snapshot, created_by, created_at, sealed_at, diagnostic_id

invariants.rule: Selection snapshots are never recomputed from later collection state.
Selection snapshots may be invalidated by diagnostics but not edited in place.

Entity.name: analysis_run
Entity.purpose: User-facing execution record created from a selection_snapshot.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, selection_snapshot_id, run_type, status, idempotency_key, delivery_preference, evidence_gate_state, diagnostic_id, created_at, started_at, completed_at, canceled_at, expires_at

invariants.rule: Every run references one sealed selection_snapshot.
analysis_run_steps and queue messages are internal details keyed by analysis_run_id.

Entity.name: analysis_run_step_input
Entity.purpose: Explicitly declares the selection item or artifact a worker step may read.
Entity.fields: id, analysis_run_step_id, input_kind, selection_snapshot_item_id, artifact_id, position, required, metadata, created_at

invariants.rule: Report and research steps consume transcript_artifact or text_corpus_artifact inputs and must not discover raw speech media ad hoc.

Entity.name: artifact
Entity.purpose: Run output, preview, or evidence object.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, stored_object_id, analysis_run_id, kind, status, content_type, checksum, size_bytes, preview, visibility, retention_state, created_at, expires_at, deleted_at

invariants.rule: Artifact access requires channel-account and run authorization.
Unavailable artifacts are represented with status and diagnostics.

Entity.name: artifact_subject
Entity.purpose: Lineage link from artifacts to runs, steps, snapshots, selected items, media assets, or diagnostics.

invariants.rule: Transcript artifacts link back to the selected item and step that produced them.
Report and research artifacts link to the text artifacts they consumed when lineage is needed.

Entity.name: diagnostic
Entity.purpose: Structured warning, rejection, failure, and operator evidence.
Entity.fields: id, channel_account_id, subject_type, subject_id, severity, code, message, context, correlation_id, created_at

invariants.rule: Every validation rejection has a diagnostic record or inline diagnostic envelope.
Diagnostics do not leak secrets, raw tokens, or private object links.

LifecycleRules.analysis-run: queued -> claiming -> running -> succeeded | partially_succeeded | failed | cancel_requested | canceled | expired
LifecycleRules.rule: Transitions must be stored with timestamps and diagnostic context for non-happy paths.
Cancellation is cooperative and records whether source processing, analysis, or artifact publication had already started.

Resolve Telegram chat/user scope into channel_account before every target public product request.
